privacyText: This closed beta stores your email, nickname, expertise, repair reports, and technical reviews to operate the service. Reports stay private unless you separately allow community sharing and are peer reviewed. External diagnosis tasks are visible only to authorized reviewers and the submitting API client. Do not include personal, employer, or confidential information in technical text. You can request account and associated data deletion from Profile.
deleteAccountHelp: Permanently remove your account, reports, drafts, expertise and review contributions. Enter your password to confirm.
accountDeleted: Account and associated data were deleted.
deleteError: Account deletion could not be completed.
